MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The alligator leads and toggle switches fit my breadboard, PCB, and relay projects because they help me make temporary connections and add simple manual controls.",
    "The caliper feels useful for checking component dimensions and hardware fit, connecting my electronics work with practical projects like fitting furniture casters."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The specialized tap requires a specific threading job I have not shown any need for; general hardware use does not make that exact tool useful to me now.",
    "The printer and filament assume a new activity and equipment setup that my history does not establish.",
    "More LEDs and several alternative probe sets relate to electronics, but I already bought a kit containing LEDs and would choose one simple lead set before adding overlapping supplies."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in small electronics projects seems to have been stretched into interest in almost any workshop or maker equipment.",
    "The repeated test-lead accessories assume that several ways to make similar connections are all useful purchases at the same time."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more likely to choose a part when it has a clear job alongside the breadboards, relay, and components I have already bought.",
    "Previous purchases can mean I already have enough of a supply, especially LEDs, rather than that I need another large batch.",
    "Related equipment is only useful when I have the setup and a concrete project for it; electronics purchases alone do not establish a need for 3D printing."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my practical electronics interests but sometimes confuse a related hobby or overlapping accessory with a clear next project need."
}
